SWT301 — PE Practice 2 (SU26 format)

PasswordPolicy review · calcShippingFee unit tests (3-condition MC/DC) · Ride Fare Estimate black-box · 85 minutes · 10 marks

1. Overview

This paper follows the SU26 practical-exam format of SWT301 (template SWT301_SU26_Template.xlsx: sheet Q1 issue list · sheet Q2 UTCID grid · sheet Q3 test cases). It is a NEW paper written in the style of the real ones — and it goes further: your corrected code is executed, your coverage is measured on instrumented code, and every test case you write is run against a reference implementation of the specification.

Rules of the real paper (keep them while practising): 85 minutes; no IDE; answers in English; every answer must reflect THIS paper — irrelevant keywords give zero for that question; expected results always come from the specification, never from the code.

How answers are recorded here: each sheet of the template becomes one JavaScript file that declares an array — one object per row/column of the template (see “Data model”). Edit only the files in answers/.

Main features

  • Question 1 (3 marks) — review PasswordPolicy.isStrong: at least 8 issues with line, type and fix; then correct the method.
  • Question 2 (3 marks) — the MINIMUM unit test cases for 100% statement coverage, 100% decision coverage and MC/DC of the compound conditions of calcShippingFee.
  • Question 3 (4 marks) — black-box test cases for the Ride Fare Estimate function: validation · business rules (decision table) · boundary values.

General requirements

  • Expected results come from the SPECIFICATION. When the code disagrees, the test case FAILS — that is your finding.
  • Use concrete values. Strings exactly as the specification prints them.
  • Question 2 is graded like the template rule: marks ÷ minimum number of tests — an extra test case costs marks.

2. Required project structure

answers/
├── q1-issues.js      ← Question 1  : const ISSUES = [...]       (sheet Q1)
├── q1-fixed.js       ← Question 1  : function isStrong(...)   (corrected — JavaScript twin)
├── q2-utcid.js       ← Question 2  : const UTCIDS = [...]       (sheet Q2 — one object per UTCID column)
└── q3-testcases.js   ← Question 3  : const TEST_CASES = [...]   (sheet Q3 — one object per row)

3. UI wireframe

+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                     RIDE FARE ESTIMATE                         |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Booking Code    [ e.g. RB001                              ]   |
|  Distance (km)   [ e.g. 12.5                               ]   |
|  Car Type        [ -- Select car type --                 v ]   |  4-seat / 7-seat
|  Pickup Hour     [ 0 - 23                                  ]   |
|  Promo Code      [ optional, e.g. SAVE10                   ]   |
|                                                                |
|                      [ Estimate Fare ]                         |
|  Estimated Fare: 116,000 VND.                                  |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+

4. Data model

Answer records — ISSUES[i] · UTCIDS[i] · TEST_CASES[i]

FieldTypeNotes
ISSUES[i].linenumber | "2-4"line number(s) in the listing of Question 1
ISSUES[i].typestringone of LOGIC, BOUNDARY, CALCULATION, VALIDATION, EXCEPTION, DATA_TYPE, COMPILE, TEST_DATA, CONVENTION, PERFORMANCE, SECURITY, RESOURCE
ISSUES[i].severity · description · fixstringHigh/Medium/Low · what is wrong and why · the concrete change
UTCIDS[i].id · inputstring · objectUTCID01… · { weightGram, zone, isMember } — concrete values
UTCIDS[i].expectednumberthe return value required by the SPECIFICATION
UTCIDS[i].type · status"N"|"A"|"B" · "P"|"F"Normal / Abnormal / Boundary · Passed / Failed when run against the code
TEST_CASES[i].id · description · preconditionstringe.g. "A01" · "Verify that…" · state before the test
TEST_CASES[i].stepsstring[]numbered procedure
TEST_CASES[i].dataobject{ bookingCode, distance, carType, pickupHour, promoCode } — strings as typed/selected ("" = empty)

Sample data

// answers/q1-issues.js
{ line: 7, type: 'BOUNDARY', severity: 'High', description: 'i <= password.length() reads one character too far.', fix: 'Use i < password.length().' }
// answers/q2-utcid.js
{ id: 'UTCID01', input: { weightGram: 0, zone: 'INNER', isMember: false }, expected: -1, type: 'A', status: 'P' }
// answers/q3-testcases.js
{
    id: 'A01', description: 'Verify that an empty Booking Code is rejected',
    precondition: 'User is on the Ride Fare Estimate screen; bookings RB001–RB003 exist',
    steps: ['Enter Booking Code = (empty)', 'Enter Distance = 10', 'Select Car Type = 4-seat', 'Enter Pickup Hour = 14', 'Enter Promo Code = (empty)', 'Click Estimate Fare'],
    data: { bookingCode: '', distance: '10', carType: '4-seat', pickupHour: '14', promoCode: '' },
    expected: 'Booking Code is required.',
  }

5. Functional requirements

1. Q1.1 — Issue list (code review) 2 marks

Problem description — password strength. isStrong(password, username) returns true when the password is strong:

  • A null password, or a null/empty username, is invalid input ⇒ IllegalArgumentException.
  • Length from 8 to 64 characters inclusive.
  • At least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one digit.
  • It must not contain the username, compared ignoring case.
 1  public class PasswordPolicy {
 2      public static boolean isStrong(String password, String username) {
 3          if (password.length() < 8 || password.length() > 64) {
 4              return false;
 5          }
 6          boolean hasUpper = false, hasLower = false, hasDigit = false;
 7          for (int i = 0; i <= password.length(); i++) {
 8              char c = password.charAt(i);
 9              if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) hasUpper = true;
10              if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) hasLower = true;
11              if (Character.isLetter(c)) hasDigit = true;
12          }
13          if (password.contains(username)) {
14              return false;
15          }
16          return hasUpper || hasLower && hasDigit;
17      }
18  
19      public static void main(String[] args) {
20          String p = "Abcdef12";
21          if (isStrong(p, "abc") == "true") {
22              System.out.println("OK");
23          }
24      }
25  }

Issue types: LOGIC wrong condition/flow · BOUNDARY off-by-one, > vs >= · CALCULATION wrong formula/unit · VALIDATION missing input check · EXCEPTION crash risk (NPE, index, divide by 0) · DATA_TYPE wrong type, integer division, overflow, double for money · COMPILE does not compile · TEST_DATA demo/test data breaks the spec · CONVENTION magic number, naming, formatting · PERFORMANCE · SECURITY · RESOURCE unclosed stream/connection

Requirements:

  • Find at least 8 distinct issues. One object = one issue; it counts when its line AND type match a real defect.
  • Every issue has a concrete fix. Do not report legal code as a compile error.

Must use: checklist-based review desk checking

2. Q1.2 — Corrected method (runs for real) 1 mark

Requirements:

  • In answers/q1-fixed.js fix the twin isStrong(password, username) so that it satisfies the specification (character helpers are given).
  • Invalid input throws IllegalArgumentException.

Must use: debugging confirmation testing

Example:

isStrong("Abcdefg1", "john") → true      isStrong("xxJOHN123a", "john") → false

3. Q2.1 — Coverage with the minimum test set 1.5 marks

Method description. calcShippingFee returns the delivery fee of a parcel in VND. A parcel is valid when it weighs 1–30,000 g and has a non-null zone; otherwise the method returns -1. Zone "INNER" (inner city) starts at 20,000 VND; every other zone starts at 35,000 VND. Above 2,000 g, each started 500 g adds 5,000 VND. Members get 10% off when the fee is above 50,000 VND.

 1  public static int calcShippingFee(int weightGram, String zone, boolean isMember) {
 2      if (weightGram <= 0 || weightGram > 30000 || zone == null)
 3          return -1;
 4      int fee = zone.equals("INNER") ? 20000 : 35000;
 5      if (weightGram > 2000)
 6          fee += (weightGram - 2000) / 500 * 5000;
 7      if (isMember && fee > 50000)
 8          fee = fee * 90 / 100;
 9      return fee;
10  }

Requirements:

  • Choose the minimum number of test cases for 100% statement coverage, 100% decision coverage and MC/DC of BOTH compound conditions (line 2 has THREE conditions, line 7 has two).
  • Coverage is measured on the code as written. A null zone is written zone: null.

Must use: statement coverage decision coverage MC/DC

4. Q2.2 — UTCID grid: expected, type, result 1.5 marks

Requirements:

  • expected = the SPECIFICATION (per started 500 g). status = "P" when the code returns it, else "F".
  • type: A invalid input, B for 1, 2000, 2001, 30000 g (0 and 30001 may be A or B), otherwise N.

Must use: UTCID template N/A/B

5. Q3.A — Validation test cases 1 mark

Function description. A ride-hailing app estimates the fare of a booked ride.

Fields: Booking Code — required; codes in the system: RB001, RB002, RB003. Distance (km) — required, a number with at most one decimal, > 0 and ≤ 100. Car Type — required (4-seat / 7-seat). Pickup Hour — required, an integer 0–23. Promo Code — optional; when given it must be SAVE10.

When the user clicks Estimate Fare the system performs these steps in order and stops at the first error:

  1. Booking Code: empty → Booking Code is required.; not in the system → Invalid Booking Code.
  2. Distance: empty → Distance is required.; not a number, ≤ 0 or > 100 → Distance must be a number greater than 0 and at most 100.
  3. Car Type: not selected → Car Type is required.
  4. Pickup Hour: empty → Pickup Hour is required.; not an integer 0–23 → Pickup Hour must be an integer from 0 to 23.
  5. Promo Code: not empty and not SAVE10 → Invalid Promo Code.
  6. Calculate the fare:
    • Distance fare: the opening fare 20,000 VND covers the first 2 km; each started km from 2 to 25 km costs 12,000; each started km beyond 25 km costs 9,000.
    • 7-seat car: distance fare × 1.3. Night pickup (22:00–05:59, i.e. hour ≥ 22 or ≤ 5): × 1.2.
    • SAVE10: 10% off the fare, at most 20,000 VND.
  7. Display Estimated Fare: [x] VND. with thousands separators.

Calculation examples

DistanceCarPickup hourPromoCalculationResult
1.5 km4-seat14—opening fare20,000
10 km4-seat14—20,000 + 8 × 12,000116,000
10 km7-seat14—116,000 × 1.3150,800
10 km4-seat23—116,000 × 1.2139,200
30 km4-seat14—20,000 + 23 × 12,000 + 5 × 9,000341,000
10 km4-seat14SAVE10116,000 − 11,600104,400
30 km4-seat14SAVE10341,000 − min(34,100; 20,000)321,000

Requirements:

  • One test case for EVERY message, and for each different reason behind a shared message (distance: text, 0, negative, above 100; hour: negative, 24, decimal).
  • The optional Promo Code: test both “empty” (allowed) and an unknown code.

Must use: equivalence partitioning test case template

6. Q3.B — Business rules (reduced decision table) 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Cover the 8 combinations of Car Type × Night × Promo (R1–R8) and R9 — the promo discount capped at 20,000.
  • Compute every expected amount exactly (multiply in this order: 7-seat, night, then promo).

Must use: decision table testing

7. Q3.C — Boundary values 1 mark

Requirements:

  • Distance 0.1 / 2.0 / 2.1 / 25.0 / 25.1 / 100; hour 5 / 6 and 21 / 22; the cap edge (fare = 200,000 and a fare just above it).

Must use: 2-value BVA

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
ISSUESanswers/q1-issues.js — Question 1 issue list
isStrong(…)answers/q1-fixed.js — corrected method
UTCIDSanswers/q2-utcid.js — UTCID columns of Question 2
TEST_CASESanswers/q3-testcases.js — test cases of Question 3

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Q1.1 — Issue list (code review)2
2Q1.2 — Corrected method (runs for real)1
3Q2.1 — Coverage with the minimum test set1.5
4Q2.2 — UTCID grid: expected, type, result1.5
5Q3.A — Validation test cases1
6Q3.B — Business rules (reduced decision table)2
7Q3.C — Boundary values1
Total10

Common deductions

  • Q2 with 4 tests for line 2: MC/DC of a three-condition OR needs each condition true ALONE — 0 g, 30001 g and a null zone are three different tests.
  • Expected fee copied from the code (floor division) instead of the spec (“started 500 g”).
  • Q1: reporting line 3 as a boundary error (8 and 64 ARE accepted) or line 16 as a compile error.
  • Q3: forgetting that an EMPTY promo code is valid, or computing the 7-seat and night factors in the wrong order and rounding.

8. Submission

Write your answers in the answer files on the right (they mirror the official template: one JavaScript object per test case / issue). Press Run for the visible checks and Submit for full grading, hidden checks included. Your score per question appears in the rubric table.

1. Tổng quan

Luật của đề thật (giữ khi luyện): 85 phút; không IDE; trả lời bằng tiếng Anh; câu trả lời phải bám đúng đề — có từ khoá không liên quan thì câu đó 0 điểm; kết quả mong đợi luôn lấy từ đặc tả, không lấy từ mã.

5. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. Q1.1 — Danh sách lỗi (review mã) 2 điểm

Mô tả bài toán — độ mạnh mật khẩu. isStrong(password, username) trả true khi mật khẩu mạnh:

  • Mật khẩu null, hoặc tên đăng nhập null/rỗng là dữ liệu sai ⇒ IllegalArgumentException.
  • Độ dài từ 8 tới 64 ký tự (tính cả hai đầu).
  • Có ít nhất một chữ hoa, một chữ thường và một chữ số.
  • Không được chứa tên đăng nhập, so không phân biệt hoa/thường.
 1  public class PasswordPolicy {
 2      public static boolean isStrong(String password, String username) {
 3          if (password.length() < 8 || password.length() > 64) {
 4              return false;
 5          }
 6          boolean hasUpper = false, hasLower = false, hasDigit = false;
 7          for (int i = 0; i <= password.length(); i++) {
 8              char c = password.charAt(i);
 9              if (Character.isUpperCase(c)) hasUpper = true;
10              if (Character.isLowerCase(c)) hasLower = true;
11              if (Character.isLetter(c)) hasDigit = true;
12          }
13          if (password.contains(username)) {
14              return false;
15          }
16          return hasUpper || hasLower && hasDigit;
17      }
18  
19      public static void main(String[] args) {
20          String p = "Abcdef12";
21          if (isStrong(p, "abc") == "true") {
22              System.out.println("OK");
23          }
24      }
25  }

Loại lỗi: LOGIC sai điều kiện/luồng · BOUNDARY lệch một, > với >= · CALCULATION sai công thức/đơn vị · VALIDATION thiếu kiểm đầu vào · EXCEPTION nguy cơ văng lỗi (NPE, chỉ số, chia 0) · DATA_TYPE sai kiểu, chia nguyên, tràn số, double cho tiền · COMPILE không biên dịch được · TEST_DATA dữ liệu demo/test trái đặc tả · CONVENTION số ma thuật, đặt tên, định dạng · PERFORMANCE hiệu năng · SECURITY bảo mật · RESOURCE không đóng stream/kết nối

Yêu cầu:

  • Tìm ít nhất 8 lỗi khác nhau. Mỗi object = một lỗi; được tính khi đúng dòng VÀ đúng loại.
  • Mỗi lỗi có cách sửa cụ thể. Không báo mã hợp lệ là lỗi biên dịch.

Bắt buộc dùng: checklist-based review desk checking

2. Q1.2 — Phương thức đã sửa (chạy thật) 1 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • Trong answers/q1-fixed.js sửa bản sinh đôi isStrong(password, username) cho đúng đặc tả (đã có sẵn hàm kiểm ký tự).
  • Dữ liệu sai ném IllegalArgumentException.

Bắt buộc dùng: debugging confirmation testing

Ví dụ:

isStrong("Abcdefg1", "john") → true      isStrong("xxJOHN123a", "john") → false

3. Q2.1 — Đạt độ phủ với bộ test tối thiểu 1.5 điểm

Mô tả phương thức. calcShippingFee trả phí giao một kiện hàng (VND). Kiện hợp lệ khi nặng 1–30.000 g và zone khác null; ngược lại trả -1. Zone "INNER" (nội thành) bắt đầu 20.000 đ; mọi zone khác bắt đầu 35.000 đ. Trên 2.000 g, mỗi 500 g bắt đầu cộng 5.000 đ. Thành viên được giảm 10% khi phí trên 50.000 đ.

 1  public static int calcShippingFee(int weightGram, String zone, boolean isMember) {
 2      if (weightGram <= 0 || weightGram > 30000 || zone == null)
 3          return -1;
 4      int fee = zone.equals("INNER") ? 20000 : 35000;
 5      if (weightGram > 2000)
 6          fee += (weightGram - 2000) / 500 * 5000;
 7      if (isMember && fee > 50000)
 8          fee = fee * 90 / 100;
 9      return fee;
10  }

Yêu cầu:

  • Chọn số ca tối thiểu cho 100% statement, 100% decision và MC/DC cho CẢ HAI điều kiện ghép (dòng 2 có BA điều kiện, dòng 7 có hai).
  • Độ phủ đo trên mã đúng như đang viết. Zone null ghi zone: null.

Bắt buộc dùng: statement coverage decision coverage MC/DC

4. Q2.2 — Lưới UTCID: mong đợi, loại, kết quả 1.5 điểm

Yêu cầu:

  • expected = theo ĐẶC TẢ (mỗi 500 g bắt đầu). status = "P" khi mã trả đúng, ngược lại "F".
  • type: A input sai, B cho 1, 2000, 2001, 30000 g (0 và 30001 ghi A hay B đều được), còn lại N.

Bắt buộc dùng: UTCID template N/A/B

5. Q3.A — Test case kiểm hợp lệ 1 điểm

Mô tả chức năng. Ứng dụng gọi xe ước tính giá một chuyến đã đặt.

Các trường: Booking Code — bắt buộc; mã có trong hệ thống: RB001, RB002, RB003. Distance (km) — bắt buộc, số có tối đa một chữ số thập phân, > 0 và ≤ 100. Car Type — bắt buộc (4-seat / 7-seat). Pickup Hour — bắt buộc, số nguyên 0–23. Promo Code — tuỳ chọn; nếu nhập thì phải là SAVE10.

Khi bấm Estimate Fare hệ thống làm các bước theo thứ tự và dừng ở lỗi đầu tiên:

  1. Booking Code: trống → Booking Code is required.; không có trong hệ thống → Invalid Booking Code.
  2. Distance: trống → Distance is required.; không phải số, ≤ 0 hoặc > 100 → Distance must be a number greater than 0 and at most 100.
  3. Car Type: chưa chọn → Car Type is required.
  4. Pickup Hour: trống → Pickup Hour is required.; không phải số nguyên 0–23 → Pickup Hour must be an integer from 0 to 23.

  { line: 13, type: 'VALIDATION', severity: 'Medium', description: 'username is never validated: contains(null) throws, and contains("") is always true so every password is rejected.', fix: 'Reject a null or empty username with IllegalArgumentException before the checks.' },
  { line: 7, type: 'BOUNDARY', severity: 'High', description: 'Off-by-one: i <= password.length() makes charAt(length) throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException on every call that reaches the loop.', fix: 'for (int i = 0; i < password.length(); i++)' },
  { line: 11, type: 'LOGIC', severity: 'High', description: 'Character.isLetter sets hasDigit: digits are never detected and any letter counts as a digit.', fix: 'if (Character.isDigit(c)) hasDigit = true;' },
  { line: 13, type: 'LOGIC', severity: 'High', description: 'contains() is case-sensitive; the spec forbids the username ignoring case ("JOHN" inside "xxJOHN123" for user "john").', fix: 'password.toLowerCase().contains(username.toLowerCase())' },
  { line: 16, type: 'LOGIC', severity: 'High', description: '&& binds tighter than ||: a password with only an uppercase letter is "strong".', fix: 'return hasUpper && hasLower && hasDigit;' },

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Question 1

The loop condition i <= length() makes every call that reaches it throw; isLetter is used where isDigit was meant; the username check is case-sensitive and never validated (null throws, empty matches everything); && binds tighter than ||; and the demo compares a boolean with a String, which does not compile. Line 3 is a trap — it is correct.

Question 2

Line 2 is A || B || C: MC/DC needs each condition to be true alone against the all-false baseline ⇒ 0 g, 30001 g and zone == null are three separate tests (with short-circuiting, B is only evaluated when A is false, C only when A and B are false). Line 7 is isMember && fee > 50000 ⇒ (T,T), (F,T), (T,F). Total 6. Expected values follow the spec: 8,100 g = 13 started 500 g steps ⇒ 85,000, but the code computes 12 ⇒ 80,000 ⇒ F, defect on line 6.

@ParameterizedTest
@CsvSource({ "0,INNER,false,-1", "30001,INNER,false,-1", "1500,,false,-1",
             "5000,OUTER,true,58500", "8100,INNER,false,85000", "1000,INNER,true,20000" })
void calcShippingFee(int w, String zone, boolean member, int expected) {
    assertEquals(expected, Shipping.calcShippingFee(w, zone, member));   // the empty CSV cell is null
}

Question 3

Validation: every message, every reason, and the OPTIONAL field both ways. Business rules: three binary conditions (car, night, promo) = 8 rules + the cap rule R9. Boundaries: the edges of each distance band in tenths of a km (0.1 · 2.0|2.1 · 25.0|25.1 · 100|100.1), of the night window (5|6, 21|22) and of the promo cap (200,000 exactly vs just above).

Điều kiện vòng lặp i <= length() làm mọi lời gọi chạy tới đó văng lỗi; dùng isLetter ở chỗ cần isDigit; kiểm username phân biệt hoa/thường và không hề kiểm null/rỗng; && ưu tiên hơn ||; main so boolean với String nên không biên dịch. Dòng 3 là bẫy — nó đúng.
